Card Q&A.a: No. If you play this card with no Tamers in play, you only get to play 1 blue Tamer card from your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If I play this card while I have no Tamers in play, and play a blue Tamer from my hand with this card's effect, do I then also gain 2 memory from this effect since I now have a Tamer in play?

Effect: [On Play] If you have a Tamer in play, gain 2 memory. If you don't have a Tamer in play, you may play 1 blue Tamer card from your hand without paying its memory cost.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes unsuspended during your main phase, gain 1 memory.
